name: jcouball
description: James Couball's agent plugins: cross-repo skills and commands for writing, explaining, and maintaining Ruby open source projects.

plugins.name: jcouball-writing
plugins.description: Writing and explanation tools. Strips AI tells from prose while keeping reference docs dry, and explains technical subjects in plain language without dropping the real terms.

plugins.name: jcouball-github
plugins.description: GitHub pull request workflow tools. Resolves PR review feedback and suppressed Copilot comments, folds fixes into the commits that introduced them, and requests fresh Copilot reviews.
